task.title: Recovery Briefing V1 design, architecture, zero-write calibration, and Founder prototype

result.summary: Recovery Briefing V1 is designed as a quiet Green/Yellow/Red/unavailable period state led by within-person Sleep, with sparse commentary, lightweight foam execution, non-causal training corroboration, and zero automatic Goal Confidence coupling. A strict read-only July-September replay rejected noisy rules, and nine synthetic/redacted Founder-review screenshots plus a versioned Server contract are pushed on the work branch. Nothing shipped or deployed.

tests.summary: Artifact verifier passed 9 prototype scenarios and policy guardrails; modeling runner syntax and git diff checks passed.

review.summary: Nine non-shipping renders were visually inspected across Weekly, Midweek, Monthly, insufficient-data, foam, and training-corroboration states.

zero_write_audit.summary: Production replay used REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY, verified transaction_read_only=on, emitted sanitized aggregates only, and rolled back with zero writes.

decisions_required: Founder visual approval for the quiet card and placement.
Founder approval for Green-without-commentary and Midweek no-Red semantics.
Founder approval to proceed only to prospective Server shadow calibration.
unexpected_findings: Without a period-average magnitude gate, 4 historically Green weeks would become Yellow; a two-consecutive-low-night rule would make 5 Green weeks Yellow.
Foam schedule authority begins September 15, so earlier missing days cannot be called misses.
backlog: After Founder approval, implement a Server-only shadow assessment against prospective eligible Sleep; keep strategic Sleep and clients off.
Review DEXA/Photo preceding Recovery context separately after recurring cadence calibration.
recommended_next_step: Founder reviews the nine screenshots and candidate policy; if approved, open a Server-only prospective shadow-calibration task with strategic Sleep, Confidence coupling, Native wiring, and production presentation still off.
